preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(edge, list) and len(edge) == 3 and edge[0] < edge[1] and edge[2] > 0 for edge in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge in edgeList must be a list of three elements where the start vertex is less than the end vertex and the weight is a positive integer.
The edgeList can be empty or contain any number of edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if not any(edge[0] == 0 and edge[1] == N - 1 for edge in edgeList) else True
postconditions.description: If there is no path from vertex 0 to vertex N-1, the output must be -1.
If a path exists, the output must be a non-negative integer representing the weight of the shortest path.
